policy: Every required gate must pass on the exact release candidate. A green lower-level gate cannot substitute for another gate.

gates.purpose: Repository structure, structure-only content policy, schema integrity, internal links and version/manifest coherence.
Starter manifest, profiles, migration registry and canonical synthetic control examples validate against their declared contracts.
Positive lifecycle fixtures pass and known invalid currentness/authority/evidence states fail.
All public profiles scaffold, validate and remain proportional; SMALL remains minimal.
Forward/reverse/idempotent schema migration works and lossy downgrade/pending-transaction cases fail closed.
One-current-owner semantics, currentness binding and supersession lineage are mechanically enforced.
Fresh contexts deterministically reconstruct trusted, active and strategic-return postures and fail through invalid state.
A real SQLite reference proves idempotency, rollback, restart persistence, concurrency and binding to control-state currentness.
Six unrelated project shapes install/adopt without application mutation, technical CLIENT file editing or profile over-installation.
New project scaffolds require CLIENT-confirmed product requirements, a current technical/security/network stack frame, and a dated delivery plan before material campaign initialization.
Recurring architecture feedback is metadata-only, opt-out, externally opt-in, schema-valid and does not leak project identifiers/content/paths/credentials.
Campaign execution, authority, locking, crash recovery, review freeze and strategic terminals survive adversarial tests.
Canonical commit authority, exact-branch delta refresh and fail-closed marker-owned local workspace cleanup survive adversarial tests.
Shared primitives stay centralized, tools compile and optional governance remains optional.
